items.title: Tobacco Stock Flakes Out After New CEO and Guidance Cut Announcement
items.summary: Turning Point Brands  named a new CEO and cut its full-year outlook on Monday.  Altria Group  shares dropped 1.4%, and  Philip Morris International  stock fell 1% on the news.  London-traded  British American Tobacco  shares declined 0.5%.
